# Samples by task

Every Lacuna Signer sample in this repository, grouped by feature area and task, with one column per language. Each link opens the scenario file that implements the task. The machine-readable version, with related files, run commands and docs links, is [samples.json](samples.json); its schema is [schema/samples.schema.json](schema/samples.schema.json).

## Status legend

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `current` | Recommended for new integrations. |
| `legacy` | Works and is still supported, but prefer the `current` alternative for new code. |
| `deprecated` | Kept for reference only. Do not copy into new code. |

## How to run each project

Every project is a console program that runs one scenario per execution, against the Signer instance and API key hard-coded in its config file. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before running one: each run creates real documents on that instance.

| Project | Stack | Command | Pick the scenario in | Signer URL and API key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`dotnet/console`](dotnet/console) | .NET Framework 4.8 console app, NuGet `packages.config` | Open `Console.sln` in Visual Studio and press F5 | [Program.cs](dotnet/console/Console/Program.cs) | [Scenario.cs](dotnet/console/Console/Scenarios/Scenario.cs) |
| [`java/console`](java/console) | Java 8 console app, Gradle wrapper | `./gradlew run` (`gradlew.bat run` on Windows) | [App.java](java/console/src/main/java/com/lacunasoftware/signer/sample/App.java) | [Scenario.java](java/console/src/main/java/com/lacunasoftware/signer/sample/scenarios/Scenario.java) |
| [`nodejs`](nodejs) | TypeScript scripts, compiled output in `scenarios/dist` | `npm install`, then `node <scenario>.js` from `scenarios/dist` | each scenario is its own script | [scenario.ts](nodejs/scenarios/scenario.ts) |
| [`php`](php) | PHP command-line script, Composer | `composer install && php index.php` | [index.php](php/index.php) | [Scenario.php](php/Scenarios/Scenario.php) |
